claims.evidence: No VIN plate, casting number, or badge visible in the photo to confirm make/model.
No identifying marks or model-year indicators visible.
No warranty document, receipt, or seller certificate shown.
No import documents, customs sticker, or shipping marks visible.
No video or audio of the engine running; photo is static and engine is not mounted or connected to test rig.
No odometer, ECU readout, or mileage sticker visible.
No seal, bolt-torque marks, or sticker proving the block/head has not been disassembled.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be a Toyota Camry unit as claimed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine block casting number and/or VIN/ID plate.
risks.if_unproven: price as a generic unidentified used engine, not model-specific.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (knock, worn bearings, compression loss).
risks.proof: Video of engine running/idling plus audio, or a compression test reading.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (starter, injectors, sensors, ECU) not visible in the single photo.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos showing full accessory set included in the sale.

risks.risk: Hidden internal wear or damage to pistons, crankshaft, or bearings.
risks.proof: Borescope video or teardown photos of internals.

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history cannot be confirmed, claim of 'low mileage' unsupported.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from the original vehicle or service history documents.

risks.risk: Origin (true tokunbo/Belgium import vs locally used/rebuilt) affects value significantly.
risks.proof: Import/customs documentation or shipping label photos.
risks.if_unproven: price as locally used (lower tier) engine.

risks.risk: Visible grime/oxidation may hide leaks or corrosion not assessable from one photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of head gasket area, oil pan, and seals.
risks.if_unproven: price assuming possible leaks requiring repair.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of engine block casting number and ID/VIN plate
Video of the engine running with audio (to check for knock)
Photos from multiple angles showing all included accessories (starter, alternator, injectors, sensors)
Compression test readings or borescope footage of cylinders
Import/customs documents or shipping label proving Belgium tokunbo origin
Odometer or mileage documentation from the source vehicle
Close-up photos of gasket, oil pan, and seal areas for leak assessment
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used, removed car engine assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as a generic unverified used engine pending proof of model, condition, and origin claims.
